note: Panel recipe for tools/panelize.py. Tabs are given as a point near the board edge (single-board coordinates, mm, KiCad front view) and the outward direction; the tool finds the exact edge. Ground copper stops 0.55 mm short of the edge everywhere. One front track (R1 to the left LEDs) runs just inside the bottom edge from x = 136 to 152 and up the left edge from y = 94 to 102, so no tab sits on those two stretches.

right side, level with the dots, between the two right LEDs
